is: One tick of the spawner, split into a pure planner, the run folders that record each launch and the process holding it, the counter-only .zaf/spawn.state, and the I/O that reserves launches, runs planning and challenger instances through the Runner port and records them in their run folders and on the epic. Nothing it plans from is kept in step by hand: running instances, slots, live claims and each epic's stage are derived on every read.
conventions: tick.rs stays pure (no port, no file); every side effect lives in mod.rs
Launch and exit are HTML-comment markers on the epic: `<!-- zaf:launch <instance> -->`, `<!-- zaf:exit <instance> <status> -->`

Derive, never keep in step: whether a launch runs is its run folder's pid (pid plus start time) checked against the process table on every read; only the counter, the launch record and the exit are written

fs.name: blockers.rs
fs.role: Blocked by: parsing, the blocker graph, its cycles and dead blockers

fs.name: blockers/
fs.role: tests.rs

fs.name: digest.rs
fs.role: the text block a real tick prints (header, who asked for a scheduler's tick, slots, each move and the count line, what it did, what runs, what was skipped, what waits on the Engineer, nothing to do) and the scheduler's next-tick and lock-held lines; pure, time injected

fs.name: digest/
fs.role: tests.rs

fs.name: inline.rs
fs.role: tick step 3: run each lane entry's zaf-kind action with zaf do, one after another, at no budget cost; a failure never stops the rest

fs.name: inline/
fs.role: tests.rs

fs.name: mod.rs
fs.role: prepare (lost, orphaned claims, plan, reserve under spawn.lock), release_orphaned (also for one task, as `zaf spawn phase` asks), launch, launch_all, dry run

fs.name: outcome.rs
fs.role: TickOutcome { started, waits, ran, questions, asked }: what a tick did, each question raised with its cause (Asked, `asked #61 on #7: <cause>`); idle when all are empty

fs.name: phase.rs
fs.role: `zaf spawn phase`: gathers the task as the tick does and passes it through the tick's gate (app/schedule/tick.rs may_start), refusing in its words, and for a model action counts the slots under spawn.lock; releases the task's claim when its instance has ended; takes the next instance number and writes the phase run folder under spawn.lock (through app/schedule/record.rs); reads it back for the launcher; records the head the phase left and then the exit code before anything that follows; opens the run folder of an inline `zaf`-kind run once the gate, asked again under spawn.lock, lets it (open_inline), marked with the tick's process

fs.name: phase/
fs.role: tests.rs

fs.name: record.rs
fs.role: TickRecord::last: the last line of the trace (.zaf/ticks.jsonl) read back, its time and what the tick did; watch_running: whether a scheduler holds .zaf/scheduler.lock; both only read, nothing is written

fs.name: record/
fs.role: tests.rs

fs.name: runs.rs
fs.role: .zaf/runs/<slug>/: launch.json, the holding process in pid, exit; Run::running reads the process table

fs.name: runs/
fs.role: tests.rs

fs.name: start.rs
fs.role: tick step 6: plan the one model phase to start from the lane entries and the epic launches, the heaviest candidate (age plus priority) that fits the budget, walked by raw age, and start it without waiting; a phase ready STARVE_AFTER (30 minutes) that does not fit ends the walk, so nothing ready after it starts, whatever its priority

fs.name: start/
fs.role: tests.rs

fs.name: state.rs
fs.role: .zaf/spawn.state, the instance counter alone; derive() adds the launches that run now

fs.name: state/
fs.role: tests.rs

fs.name: stop.rs
fs.role: `zaf spawn stop`: finds the live phase run folder of a task, ends its process and group (terminate, a grace, then kill) and releases the task's claim through the Board port; none live is refused

fs.name: stop/
fs.role: tests.rs

fs.name: tests.rs
fs.role: tick and launch tests

fs.name: tick.rs
fs.role: board snapshot, derived running launches, guard and settings in, launch plan out

fs.name: tick/
fs.role: tests.rs

fs.name: waits.rs
fs.role: tick step 4: launch each lane entry's wait action detached with zaf spawn phase, never waiting for it, at no budget cost; a failed launch is logged and the rest still go

fs.name: waits/
fs.role: tests.rs

fs.name: watch.rs
fs.role: the watches a hub runs for POST /api/watch: Watches (the owner, whose drop ends every watch) and WatchHandle (start and stop, which end nothing by being dropped); a watch is the scheduler's loop on a thread of the hub's process, holding the project's scheduler.lock as the hub, so watch_running reads it; one watch a project whoever started it, and a stop ends it after its current tick, never a scheduler another process holds; Tick is what runs one tick; SCHEDULED_BY_VAR tells a tick it is the hub's scheduler's own

fs.name: watch/
fs.role: tests.rs

notes: Each open epic gets at most one launch a tick, by its stage: planning for a signed epic with no tasks (once per signature), the challenger for a planned one (once per epic), none for a challenged one (its tasks are built by their phases, never by a launched instance); tick.rs names release alone as NOT_BUILT
The verb never loops; an external timer runs `zaf spawn --once`
The launch prompt is assets/spawn/epic-prompt.txt (planning, challenger); the pack's standing briefs are planning-brief.md and challenger-brief.md, and .zaf/roles/<role>.md wins over them
Slots and guard thresholds come from the manifest's [spawn]; the guard level is read from .zaf/guard.json; each launch holds one slot
